scope: Read-only reference preparation for the human-requested next single-five landscape test. No case/runtime/plan/image generation frozen or launched.

actual_pixel_observations.surface: Actual Chrome public template preview, fully rendered screenshot; no login, purchase, upload or customization
actual_pixel_observations.layout: Landscape preview with vertical halves: orange information field left, green photographic performer field right. It is a landscape source, not proof of an exact16:9 template.
actual_pixel_observations.image_crop: Bust/portrait crop occupies the right field, with performer lettering above/behind and across the foreground below; no actual photo authorship or AI/non-AI certification inferred.
actual_pixel_observations.color: Orange/green separate zones while repeated orange lettering joins photo to the information field. This palette is not a prescribed next-test default.
actual_pixel_observations.information: A large left event descriptor leads to a joined date/time line, multiline place and a bordered ticket-price group; small web information occupies the base.
actual_pixel_observations.typography: Heavy condensed practical type changes role/scale between event, logistics and performer.
actual_pixel_observations.material_emotion: Photographic light/skin/clothing and hard flat graphic fields create a mainstream promotional voice; generic portrait/header packages and glossy skin are not automatically high-end.
actual_pixel_observations.use: Consider purposeful grouping and image/information linkage, not identical split-half coordinates, palette, character, text, rounded frame or a five-template style roster.

actual_pixel_observations.surface: Actual Chrome public template preview, fully rendered screenshot
actual_pixel_observations.layout: Despite banner naming, the actual preview is tall portrait; do not cite this as a landscape template.
actual_pixel_observations.image_color_material: Outlined clothing/shoes/bags on stands use green, blue and cream; a blue checker floor anchors the merchandise, with a burgundy title and foot band.
actual_pixel_observations.information_typography: Irregular bold upper title and small date badge lead through the market scene to event description and bottom time/place. The published title does not reliably describe actual palette, hierarchy or orientation.
actual_pixel_observations.use: Records why actual pixels matter. Do not borrow this conventional header/central-merchandise/footer arrangement as a default for the next five landscape outputs.

research_limits: No source art is a native-generation attachment or copied into the repository.
Source names/search labels are discovery aids only.
Canva contributes approachable information and subject recognition; its templates do not establish high-end craft or non-AI authorship.
Previously actually viewed studio work supplies full visual-system references; future case-specific application remains to be designed after I closes.
